title: அரசியல் எனக்குப் பிடிக்கும்
author: Cho Ramaswamy
description: A witty, incisive Tamil book on Indian politics by the legendary satirist and playwright Cho Ramaswamy — a must-read for anyone trying to make sense of the political landscape.

title: Can't Hurt Me
author: David Goggins
description: David Goggins — Navy SEAL, ultramarathon runner, and one of the world's toughest endurance athletes — shares how mastering your mind is the only way to unlock your true potential and overcome any obstacle.

file: The Diary Of a Young Girl.jpg
title: The Diary Of a Young Girl
author: Anne Frank
description: The remarkable diary kept by Anne Frank during two years in hiding with her family in Nazi-occupied Amsterdam — an enduring testament to the human spirit in the face of unimaginable horror.

title: Joy: The Happiness that comes from within
author: Osho
description: Osho challenges the idea that happiness depends on external circumstances, arguing that joy is our natural state — something to be uncovered rather than pursued.

title: The Long Tail
author: Chris Anderson
description: Wired editor Chris Anderson argues that the future of business lies not in blockbusters but in the vast, overlooked market of niche products — a prescient framework for the digital age.
